name: Lucky Tattoo
body:
You were plagued by bad luck until you purchased a “lucky tattoo” from a mysterious traveling artist. On that day, your luck did, indeed, seem to improve for the better.

Benefit: Once per game-session, when called upon to make a d20 roll, you may roll two dice and choose the better result.
